sample_points_from_meshes: sample points with normals and textures from PyTorch3D meshes using sample_points_from_meshes
init_meshes: create random PyTorch3D meshes with configurable vertices, faces, and optional vertex textures
test_sampling_output: test that sampled points from a sphere lie on a unit sphere and pyramid points lie on faces
test_texture_sampling: test texture interpolation on sampled points using barycentric coordinates across mesh faces
sample_points_with_init: benchmark mesh point sampling performance by initializing random meshes and measuring sample_points_from_meshes
